{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute the change in biomarker from baseline to final
# Only for patients with valid baseline and final values (already ensured)
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean change
mean_change = df['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute the median change
median_change = df['biomarker_change'].median()

# Compute the proportion of patients with improvement (positive change)
prop_improved = (df['biomarker_change'] > 0).mean()

# Print the results
mean_change, median_change, prop_improved"}
